sessions.level: When life gets overwhelming, and you need to de-stress and unwind, our signature journey is here for you. Think of this experience as a massage for the mind. Navigate through our serene spaces designed for optimal relaxation and restoration, including our immersive theatre room, light & sound therapy dome, breathwork and meditation lounge and thermae. Please know our thermae is a silent space. Guests receive refreshments, a towel and a locker for maximum comfort each visit.
